# The JavaScript files this product keeps (new code is TypeScript: CLAUDE.md "Conventions"). Read from the PR's base by
# CI's `policy` job (.github/ci/ts-only.ts), so a PR can't add its own entry. One path per line; a path ending in `/` covers
# every file under it. Each entry is a file something loads by a fixed .js/.mjs name.
# Paperclip's plugin host loads these inside the Paperclip container, by the .js entry points in its package.json.
services/paperclip-events/
# A git credential helper invoked by path from host git config: renaming it breaks existing host checkouts.
ops/git-credential-app.mjs
# Tool config the linters load as JavaScript.
services/board/eslint.config.mjs
services/board/.stylelintrc.mjs
# A browser script served as is, and its copy in the agent image.
modules/apps-platform/design-system/kit.js
services/computer/images/agent-base/design-system/kit.js
# The app starter's runtime files: every app repo carries them under these names (skills, evals and the sign-in check name
# them), and the copy baked into the agent image.
modules/apps-platform/starter/
services/computer/images/agent-base/app-starter/
